FRIDAY SIGN / POST-PRINT STATE: Friday 20260731 is E-owned and the D-1 state is coherently bullish enough for a CALL. Thursday's session signed flow is +1099 lots with two-sided session b_share 0.507. The big-print sample is thick (129) and strongly buy-skewed at 0.569. Phase flow is +231 / +905 / -37, so the late phase flattens but does not erase the first two positive phases. The prior storage print is also bullish relative to survey: current-vintage +28 Bcf versus a strictly pre-print +37 consensus, surprise -9 Bcf (tighter injection than expected). I do not claim that surprise sign alone sorts direction; here it aligns with the guard-clean D-1 buy tape, which is the important combination.

WEATHER / POSITIONING: the D-1-evening D0 CDD is 13.829 after +0.317 and the Friday 08:00 cycle adds another +0.174 to 14.003, a modest supportive same-day revision. COT remains net short (-102756) but improved +2953 WoW and sits at 17.92 1y percentile, so this is not a fresh extreme-and-worsening covering stack. I therefore call the move continuation on tape + tighter storage, not a squeeze. Forward weather is a different story: Saturday remains 13.579, Sunday 12.084 and Monday 11.713 CDD. That cooling-demand fade matters for the OUTGOING weekend handoff and is why the Friday path trims from its midday high rather than extending into the close.

BIDWEEK / STRUCTURE: bidweek day 5 is active and the live calendar/scored front is U26. GSCI/BCOM roll programs are not active. The frozen price-derived structural blocks remain Q26 anchor vintage, so their price-derived values are still excluded; live deterministic U26 calendar is used only for timing context. No current U26 expiry squeeze condition is implied with 19 business days to expiry.

MAGNITUDE / PATH: n0 sigma10 is ~621, and a +1099 flow / 0.569 big-print buy state aligned with a -9 Bcf survey surprise supports a roughly one-sigma +600 call. I keep only +50 in the overnight gap and let the US morning carry the extension. The path rises through midday, then trims as the same-day catalyst is realized and forward CDD slopes lower into the weekend, closing +550 ex-gap = +600 total. Falsifier: a clean live sell-side reversal or evidence that the post-print buy tape was fully absorbed would invalidate the continuation. CALL, medium confidence.

WEEKEND HANDOFF: unlike 07/24, the main bullish catalyst here is substantially realized before the weekend: the tighter storage print is already known and Friday D0 weather is already in the market, while the forward CDD ladder cools into Monday. I therefore emit a crest-trim/fadeable weekend state with a modest DOWN Monday prior driven by weather-demand decay, not because Friday itself is bearish. A should re-check weekend revisions and Sunday tape before B owns the next Monday.
